_comment: Version-controlled record of ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json, the agy CLI's
review profile. Nothing installs from this file — it is the copy to diff against when
a review behaves unexpectedly. agy is used for code review only; actual coding happens
in the Antigravity 2.0 app, which keeps its own permissions elsewhere.
IMPORTANT: agy merges permissions from TWO files. This one, and
Antigravity 2.0 app's accumulated click-through grants. That second file is the app's
and must never be edited from here; anything in it we do not want is cancelled by an
entry in `deny` below, because Deny beats Allow across both files (measured).
The app appends to it every time Tim clicks 'always allow', so the deny list can fall
behind — diff the two when a review does something it should not have been able to.
agy REWRITES the live settings file on startup and drops every key whose value equals
the built-in default — toolPermission, allowNonWorkspaceAccess and notifications all
vanished from the installed copy on the first run. The behaviour still applies (a read
outside the workspace was correctly refused with allowNonWorkspaceAccess absent), so
this file keeps them written out as the explicit record of intent. A key missing from
the live file is not drift; a key with a DIFFERENT value is.
